message.content:
This editorial illustration features an orange and yellow background with flame-like shapes and grey clouds at the bottom. The word "TEMPO" is written in large white letters across the top, partially obscured by the figures. Two men in dark suits, white shirts, and ties are riding a dark blue motorcycle. The man in the front wears glasses and a red tie, gripping the handlebars with an intense expression. The man behind him has grey hair, an open-mouthed expression, and clutches a brown leather briefcase as green banknotes fly around them.

The text "WASWAS RUPIAH" is prominently displayed in bold white letters across the center. Smaller Indonesian text is located in the upper corners and lower left, including the date "11-17 MEI 2026" and a barcode. The man in the back wears a dark tie, and his hair appears windswept. The motorcycle is positioned diagonally, facing towards the lower right. The overall style is a colorful, detailed comic-book illustration with heavy black outlines. Small black text below the main title begins with "Bank Indonesia keteteran..." and ends with "H.62".
